isolation_notes: Assistant's own persistent cloud Linux machine and browser profile, shared with the user's other assistants; no other carts, jobs, memories or accounts were touched.

Prior exposure: this conversation already held the earlier six-task paces-everyday pilot, and that kit's zip contained an older form-trace/confirmation file from a previous run. It was not opened or reused here; all evidence comes from this run.

deviations: tool_calls counts only the browser worker's reported actions (8, screenshots included). Coordinator setup and report calls are excluded, and the 50-call limit was not machine-enforced.
Browser mode is recorded as visual: the browser worker works from screenshots and pixel-coordinate clicks and typing in the box browser, at a 1280x800 display.

metrics.source: Active time runs from the browser open (10:34:48) to the confirmation being observed (10:35:55), by worker-reported wall-clock timestamps with 1 s precision. Elapsed time runs from the package download (10:34:38) to the confirmation. Both exclude report writing. tool_calls counts the browser worker's actions only. Tokens are unavailable.
